caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of textile with a repeating pattern of large roses and clusters of smaller flowers with leaves across the surface. The flowers are rendered in shades of red, pink, and brown, with the leaves in varying hues of green, and some brown shading. The background is filled with a light tan, basket-weave or mesh-like texture, overlaid with curving, decorative cream-colored lines that create a scrolling vine motif interwoven amongst the flowers. The edges of the textile sample are slightly frayed, and the textile is placed on a larger, off-white or cream sheet of paper. The drawing also contains a faint signature or name, "E. MILLER", near the bottom right corner.
title: Glazed Chintz
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
